description: This file defines a class JwtTokenGenerator responsible for creating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for authentication purposes within the application. It utilizes Microsoft identity model libraries and options configured via dependency injection to generate tokens with specific claims and signing credentials.

classes.name: JwtTokenGenerator
classes.description: A class that implements token creation logic using issuer options to generate JWT tokens with claims such as subject, token ID, and issued at timestamp.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a given username, including various claims and signing credentials, and returns it as a string.
